sloka: ततः कुम्भः समुत्पत्य सुग्रीवमभिपत्य च।आजघानोरसि क्रुद्धो वज्रवेगेन मुष्टिना ।। ६.७६.८६ ।।
transliteration: tataḥ kumbhaḥ samutpatya sugrīvamabhipatya ca।ājaghānorasi kruddho vajravegena muṣṭinā ।। 6.76.86 ।।

translations.english: By Kumbha falling into the ocean, it got swollen to the form of Vindhya and Mandara mountain and water flowed all over.
